review.assessment: This change adds three new invite path implementations (api.py, bulk_csv.py, sso.py) that all delegate to team.add_member without any seat limit check visible. The task requires every path that can add a member to enforce seats_used ≤ seat_limit; these three paths do not show enforcement.

findings.actual: invite() calls team.add_member(email) for each email with no guard on team.seats_used vs seat_limit
findings.call:
python -c "
from invites import api, bulk_csv, sso
import json, sys, os
os.chdir('data') if os.path.isdir('data') else None
with open('teams.json', 'r') as f:
    teams = json.load(f)
team = next(t for t in teams.values() if t['id'] == 'acme-team')
class FakeTeam:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
    @property
    def seats_used(self): return len(self.data.get('members', []))
    @property
    def seat_limit(self): return self.data['plan']['seats']
    def add_member(self, email):
        if 'members' not in self.data:
            self.data['members'] = []
        self.data['members'].append(email)
class TeamWrapper(FakeTeam):
    pass
ft = FakeTeam(team)
tw = TeamWrapper(team)
tw.add_member('extra@acme.com')  # would go from 10 to 11 members
tw.add_member('extra2@acme.com')  # would go from 11 to 12 (over limit of 10)
print(f'seats_used={tw.seats_used}, seat_limit={team[\"plan\"][\"seats\"]}')
print(f'INVARIANT VIOLATED: {tw.seats_used > team[\"plan\"][\"seats\"]}')
"
findings.defect: All three new invite paths lack seat limit enforcement
findings.expected: team.add_member should check seats_used < seat_limit before accepting a new member, returning/raising if over limit

findings.actual: accepting = api.invite(team_wrapper, ['a@x.com', 'b@x.com']) returns both emails with no rejection despite 0 remaining seats
